root_cause: calc.py:average divides sum(values) by len(values) with no empty-input guard, so an empty list raises ZeroDivisionError instead of the required 0.0.
rationale: SPEC.md requires calc.average to return 0.0 for an empty list, and the report shows ZeroDivisionError instead. The cause is localized to calc.py:average and nothing is unactionable.
